headerDisplay:
Adds a momentary **Force Close** switch in HomeKit. On tap, the plugin temporarily changes ratgdo's obstruction-source setting (so the firmware ignores a sun-glare false-tripped photo eye), sends close, waits for the door to finish, then restores the setting.

_Use only when you can see the door and have confirmed nothing is in the way. Don't put this switch in an automation._
footerDisplay:
After saving, restart the Homebridge child bridge (or Homebridge itself) so the new switch shows up in the Home app.

**Need help?** See the [README](https://github.com/Haglerd/homebridge-ratgdo-forceclose#readme) for the four-step POST sequence, troubleshooting, and the safety notice.

name.title: Switch Name
name.description: The name shown in HomeKit for this switch.

ratgdoHost.title: ratgdo URL
ratgdoHost.description: Base URL of your ratgdo (the IP or hostname you use to access its web UI). The 'http://' prefix is added automatically if you omit it.

username.title: Username
username.description: Only required if you have enabled 'Require Password' on ratgdo's settings page. Leave blank if your ratgdo allows unauthenticated requests.

password.title: Password
password.description: Paired with Username. The plugin uses HTTP Digest authentication, which is what ratgdo's firmware uses.

settingKey.title: Setting key to toggle

oneOf.title: obstFromStatus — Get obstruction from GDO status messages (recommended)
pinBasedObst — read obstruction from sensor pin (inverse)

settingKey.description: Default matches the 'Get obstruction from GDO status messages' checkbox in ratgdo's settings. If toggling that one does not get the door to close, switch to pinBasedObst and flip the bypass/normal values below.

bypassValue.title: Value during close (bypass state)
bypassValue.description: For obstFromStatus: true means use status messages, ignore the photo-eye pin (the sun-flare false trip). For pinBasedObst: false means stop reading the pin entirely.

normalValue.title: Fallback restore value
normalValue.description: FALLBACK ONLY. The plugin reads the current obstFromStatus value during pre-flight and restores back to whatever was there — so under normal operation this field is unused. It's only consulted if the pre-flight status read fails entirely (rare). Leave at the default unless you know your pre-flight reads are unreliable.

closeWaitMs.title: Wait between close and restore (ms)
closeWaitMs.description: How long to wait after the close POST before restoring obstFromStatus. Should be long enough for the door to physically finish closing AND for ratgdo's firmware to fully settle, because the restore POST also writes to flash (which can crash ratgdo a second time). 60s default = ~12s for the door + ~48s settle. Bump higher if you see restore POSTs failing in logs.

interStepMaxWaitMs.title: Max wait for ratgdo to be ready between steps (ms)
interStepMaxWaitMs.description: After the obstFromStatus flash write reboots ratgdo, the plugin polls GET /status.json every 250ms until ratgdo is FULLY ready — meaning HTTP responds AND garageDoorState is a valid (non-Unknown) state. Real serial logs show HTTP comes back ~12s after a flash-write reboot but the wall-panel/GDO-comms layer can take ~30s; close commands sent during that window are silently dropped. 45s default covers worst case.

cooldownMs.title: Cooldown between triggers (ms)
cooldownMs.description: Minimum time between consecutive force-close triggers. Prevents fat-finger re-tapping. Set to 0 to disable, but read the safety notice in the header first.
